issues.observed: A PowerShell source probe placed command execution and LASTEXITCODE inside one hashtable expression, so parsing failed before Git ran.
issues.recovery: Capture command output and exit code in scalar variables before constructing the receipt object.
issues.recurrence_guard: Separate command execution from PowerShell object projection.

issues.observed: The first manifest replay loop crossed the tool yield boundary and returned no attributable receipt; it earned zero manifest credit.
issues.recovery: Audit concrete Git processes and locks, then use one captured ls-tree map per revision with bounded comparison output.
issues.recurrence_guard: Require a completed attributable replay receipt before manifest credit.

issues.observed: An inline Python -c manifest command was mangled by nested JSON and PowerShell quoting and raised a syntax error.
issues.recovery: Send literal source to Python through standard input.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use python stdin for multiline repository diagnostics.

issues.observed: A second Python -c attempt lost embedded quotes through native argument processing and raised a syntax error.
issues.recovery: Pipe the literal script body to python - and rerun only the read-only comparison.
issues.recurrence_guard: Do not pass quote-rich multiline code through a native -c argument.

issues.observed: Global roster, auth, index, reflection, and toolbox snapshots still described the Elowen-to-Sylven cursor even though the newer acknowledged Caelen-to-Eiren baton controlled v658-v4.
issues.recovery: Retain the stale cursor, apply documented precedence to the newest live activation, and defer shared snapshot updates until terminal closeout.
issues.recurrence_guard: Compare every shared route cursor against the newest acknowledged live and committed baton before action.

issues.observed: A broad preregistration directory listing exceeded the output envelope and was truncated, earning no inventory credit.
issues.recovery: Use exact filenames, filtered rg inventories, and bounded counts.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never render a large repository directory inventory without a hard bound.

issues.observed: A proposal-index probe assumed a records array and failed because the frozen chain uses prior_proposals plus new_proposals.
issues.recovery: Inspect top-level keys, then concatenate the two declared arrays.
issues.recurrence_guard: Inspect JSON keys before traversing inherited ledgers.

issues.observed: The first roster validation guessed a state subdirectory that does not exist and raised FileNotFoundError.
issues.recovery: Discover the exact skill file inventory and validate references/current-roster.json.
issues.recurrence_guard: Resolve referenced paths from SKILL.md or exact inventory before execution.

issues.observed: The first auth validation guessed a nonexistent script name and earned no validation credit.
issues.recovery: Discover the exact validator filename and invoke validate_auth_permission_state.py with an external D-drive receipt.
issues.recurrence_guard: Discover exact skill entrypoints before invoking them.

issues.observed: A parallel preflight wrapper returned empty drive and version results even though its validator branches returned, so it earned no environment credit.
issues.recovery: Run drive and version probes serially through completion.
issues.recurrence_guard: Do not combine unrelated preflight branches when each receipt must be attributable.

issues.observed: Combined source status probes yielded without completed tracked-clean results and earned no clean-state credit.
issues.recovery: Use bounded scalar index, untracked, divergence, and live-remote probes, retaining the earlier verified clean receipt.

issues.observed: PowerShell command transport mangled the @{upstream} revision token into an invalid encoded argument.
issues.recovery: Use the explicit origin branch ref for divergence and equality checks.
issues.recurrence_guard: Prefer explicit remote refs across command-transport boundaries.

issues.observed: A lock audit tried to Join-Path an already absolute git-common-dir and produced an unsupported path format.
issues.recovery: Use the absolute common-dir output directly as a literal path.
issues.recurrence_guard: Inspect whether Git paths are absolute before resolving them.

issues.observed: A post-worktree list and untracked composite probe crossed the yield boundary without attributable output.
issues.recovery: Verify exact head and branch separately and rerun only required scalar cleanliness checks.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep large-worktree registration and cleanliness probes independent.

issues.observed: The first preregistration draft placed V6584-P24 at 0.6111 similarity to Caelen's THOS inspection-handover proposal; the draft earned zero novelty credit.
issues.recovery: Redesign P24 as a field-to-office evidence relay with orphan-note quarantine, reciprocal readback, interruption budget, and escalation timer while preserving the 0.60 threshold.
issues.recurrence_guard: Treat novelty rejection as a redesign signal; never weaken the threshold.

issues.observed: Three parallel rg file inventories returned no attributable paths despite exact known files, so the composite earned no inventory credit.
issues.recovery: Use exact Get-Item and filtered Get-ChildItem probes with explicit output limits.
issues.recurrence_guard: Require nonempty attributable output before accepting a repository inventory.

issues.observed: The first exact staged-path comparison found 40 indexed paths but only 38 expected paths because the review and validation receipt were materialized after their expected-set snapshot; it earned zero exact-review credit.
issues.recovery: Rebuild after both lifecycle files exist, restage every changed x1 path, and require exact equality between the materialized expected set and the index.
issues.recurrence_guard: Materialize review and receipt layers before the terminal x1 expected-path snapshot.
